update_event_type_availability.beforeRequest:
const B='https://api.calendly.com',has=v=>v!=null&&v.trim()!=='',id=v=>encodeURIComponent(v.trim().replace(/\/+$/,'').split('/').pop()),uri=(r,v)=>{v=v.trim();return v.startsWith('https://')?v:B+'/'+r+'/'+encodeURIComponent(v)};
const r=JSON.parse(inputs.rules);if(!Array.isArray(r))throw new Error('Rules must be a JSON array of availability rules.');request.query={event_type:uri('event_types',inputs.eventType)};request.body={availability_rule:{timezone:inputs.timezone.trim(),rules:r}};return request;
